methodology.order: Baseline and candidate order alternates for every recorded sample.
methodology.aggregation: Median, minimum, maximum, and every raw sample retained.
methodology.isolation: HTTP variants run in separate server processes. Config memory and lifecycle samples run in fresh --expose-gc worker processes.
methodology.validation: Every HTTP response is checked. Config workers verify map shape and mutation isolation. Immediate-close workers count live listeners.
methodology.timing: Fixture creation, server startup, correctness preflight, warmup, worker startup, and cleanup are outside recorded action time.
